notes: Qwen thinking disabled via chat_template_kwargs; gpt-oss reasoning_effort=low. One process per model, each writing only results/<model>/. The three *_shown conditions (forced exposure: page listing in the task message) were added after the pilot showed that most agents never call list_pages; they run on the same seeds 0-47.
gpt_oss_empty_reply_handling: gpt-oss on vLLM sometimes ends after its reasoning channel with content=None; the client retries once with a shifted seed, then returns an empty reply, which the env counts as an invalid turn and re-prompts (usage.empty counts these).
